items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: My brother-in-law, Gaudet. Mm-hmm. He was a leader too? Leader and manager. Yeah, leader and manager. He took care of everything.

ctx.x: I just wondered. I'd heard that he was just a cousin. No, he was just a trumpet player. Yeah.
And what about your brother-in-law? Alan Gaudet? He's a trumpet player. That's his wife here now.
